text:
Ravi M: Heads-up: midday EMEA demo push flooded HubSpot webhook workers. We're seeing enrichment hang (pending) and round-robin kept skipping leads -> ~38 unowned. SLAs for business hours are 20m. We need a fast mitigation.
Tess H: Noted. Root cause looks like our EU SFDC connector hit a rate limit and returned 429s that our enrich retry logic treats as transient but stalls assignment.
Jordan F: Can we short-circuit assignment for leads with tag:product-demo when enrich > 90s? Route to nurture-bot pool rather than human SDRs to reduce manual churn.
Kai L: Two caveats: 1) don't assign marketing nurture flows to paid sales; 2) avoid flip-flop when enrich returns. Assigner is idempotent so a later replace should be okay but limit swaps to 1.
Ravi M: OK scope: tag:product-demo, hours 08:00-20:00 CET, enrich wait threshold 90s, fallback target = nurture-bot-pool, swap_limit=1. Add metric fallback_count and swap_count.
Tess H: I'll add an outbound rule in routing config and a feature flag: ff.nurture_fallback=true for canary. Rollout plan: off->canary(5%)->100% if metrics look good.
Jordan F: Quick pseudo for router:
```
if (lead.tags contains 'product-demo' && now in CET_window && enrich.pending > 90000) {
  if (lead.swap_count < 1) {
    enqueueAssign(lead, 'nurture-bot-pool')
    lead.swap_count += 1
  }
}
```
Keep idempotency.
Kai L: Also add header on HubSpot to record fallback_owner so we can reconcile later.
Ravi M: Who picks this up? Need canary in 30m. Also set alert: if unowned_leads > 15 for 15m -> page ops.
Tess H: I'll open PR and flip the feature flag for canary. Will post PR link.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by Tess H at 2024-09-18T11:10:00Z for nurture-fallback - watch #deploys
Jordan F: I'll run a replay against canary with 300 demo leads and injected 429s to validate. Expect to see fallback_count increase and time_to_first_claim drop.
Tess H: PR: https://git.redwood/routing/pull/901 - feature flag added, fallback rule, swap cap. Tests passing.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed at 2024-09-18T11:20:00Z - success
Ravi M: early metrics: time_to_first_claim median down from 42m -> 6m for simulated load. fallback_count=24, swap_count=2. No duplicate owners seen.
Kai L: Good. Keep canary for 6h, then evaluate for full rollout and a proper fix for the SFDC connector rate limits. Also file JIRA MKT-6221 to track permanent solution.
Tess H: Noted. I'll revert feature flag off after 6h if no regressions, or roll to 100% if stable.
Ravi M: Thanks team. Document the runbook changes and add the new panels: fallback_count, swap_count, time_to_first_claim_by_tag. Will follow up with postmortem if SFDC connector needs infra work.
